notes.title: Release News!!!
notes.notes:
Good news!

Our game is ready for release!  (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧

For now, this will be an early access, not the final version. The release will include approximately 5 hours of content, including a demo and the second part of the game. There are 4 planned parts in the game: we plan to release the third and fourth parts during this and next year.

Unfortunately, we are facing some troubles with the platforms. We are actively working on their solution, but we cannot yet say for sure when everything will be ready. We will try to do everything as quickly as possible so that we can share our work with you as soon as possible!

notes.title: A little bit of Degraman's life.
notes.notes:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GnPIK__WkAA19HS?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GnPIK_9XIAApIK9?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GnPILADWkAAGTVX?format=jpg&name=4096x4096[/img]

In general, the question of who is really alive in Degraman is very debatable. Even Turkey (of course) will answer - "who knows?"

Here, again, we can recall the origin of the word quansie, and then the question of the state of superposition becomes even more explicit.

Perhaps in this understanding, Victor's answer "in some kind - alive" emphasizes that life and death may not be absolute states, but rather a spectrum where intermediate states exist.

We are interested to see if our dear players will conduct further discussions about the degree of "alive or dead" in relation to other quansies (especially when more of the plot begins to be unfolded)

And, perhaps, this is all of Victor's "dead inside" mood)) Everything is complicated!

notes.title: About hot art!
notes.notes:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GkAMnp_WgAAQytd?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Many of you have been waiting for more explicit content from us for a long time.

We thought to find an artist for just such illustrations, but Turkey couldn't approve any of the candidates.

Well, as usual, if you want to do it well, do it yourself, and that's why Turkey started her anatomical marathon. She studies tutorials, videos, textbooks, and draws anatomical sketches based on references. By this time, Turkey had already made 200 of the 500 planned sketches.

According to her, "progress is noticeable." However, this perfectionist bird still refuses to make illustrations for the game itself ((

After much thought (and kicking the Turkey), we came up with the idea that once a month we will post some of the best (in the opinion of Turkey) sketches on Patreon and vote on the art of the month: our patrons will choose one of the sketches and who to depict on it. After rendering, a more nude version of this art will be on the Patreon sites, and on the rest - a more clothed one.

For now, let's try this activity! Here we'll show you which sketches to choose from and which characters, but the survey itself will be on Patreon.

notes.title: The news!
notes.notes:
We're sorry we haven't been here for a long time. But we're back! (づ｡◕‿‿◕｡)づ

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GhlfVTEWwAAObtF?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

So, the news!
We want to release an incomplete version of the game soon (in the nearest six months). There will be half of the entire game, for about 5+ hours. Unfortunately we faced some problems with proofreading, otherwise we would have already done the release, but alas (((

The Steam version will most probably be early access (a one-time purchase, and then the game will be updated up to the final release, but you don't need to do additional payments). We plan to use a similar scheme in Google Play and itch.io.

Why do we choose such way to release the game?
Unfortunately, or fortunately, Victor's route comes out rather large, not the 6-10 hours that Turkey had planned in first place, but much more. 
And since it's quite difficult to release large projects in full right away, we'll release what we have. Anyone who wants to will be able to enjoy even a part of the game very soon, and at the same time support us with feedback and money.

Thank you for continuing to be with us! ｡◕‿‿◕｡

notes.notes:
An interactive novel for girls with a mystical plot and dangerous favorites.

There are many choices that have real weight - it depends only on your decisions who will survive and who will not, and which path the heroine will choose: she will remain an insignificant shadow, become like the monsters around her, or find humanity where only ashes remain.

A big update is planned in the fall (5+ hours of content)

notes.title: Act II demo
notes.notes:
Happy New Year to all!

Main news:

~~~~ on Friday we plan to post the first episode of Victor's route!~~~

And now more about this and other plans 

[olist]
[*] We are starting to build a demo version of the second act of the game. The demo version will include the first 5 chapters
[*] As an experiment, we will start posting demos in video format by episode (i.e. up to the nearest choice). You can make a next choice by poll. So your choices will affect where the plot goes :3
[*] It will be the most working material, not polished and not brought to perfection - the backgrounds may be from neural networks, CGs may be absent
[*] As we reach the end of Chapter 5, we will build a demo as an application, which we will put on stores (Steam, Google Play)
[*] If the format of the video with polls will be OK, we will continue to share working materials, but as a paid content (probably patreon)
[/olist]

Why did we come up with such an idea?
There are several reasons.

1. We don't want to work "for the desk drawer" for several years without showing anything
2. We will not need to spend time creating side content for running social networks and paid platforms. We make a game - and show it.
3. The release of the full game will not be soon. Turkey's health does not allow her to work as much as before. And we don't want to drop the quality of the game. And a long wait scares the players away (we realized this from the experience of the last act)

As a result, you will have the opportunity to see the new format, evaluate for yourself whether you are interested in this. If not, then wait for the full release :3 (here we will also clarify that the release will have all the plot options, not only those that the players chose in the polls)

notes.title: Oct'22 report
notes.notes:
[h1]Briefly[/h1]

[olist]
[*] What has been done: All the main sprites are of varying rate of detalization (from 40% to 70%) 
[*] What is planned: to make requirements for 10 BGs, to write to the artists we've found, to start editing the text written, to make sketches for the requirements, most likely to continue working on sprites
[/olist]

[h1]More detailed[/h1]

But come on, this month I, Turkey, did a good job on sprites.

The most important thing is that I found a more convenient way of working with coloring. Honestly, when I achieved one on one sprite, all my thoughts were that this style is too good and I won't be able to repeat it anymore.

But I could! And I also set up the process so that it became much more comfortable than it was before.

Well, sprites are already awesome. And most importantly, they fully reflect the atmosphere of Act 2. I'm so happy.

It was a bit sad with the BGs, it came to the realization that perhaps the process of working on them would not be as easy as it was in the past. But it is what it is 🤷

[h1]Plans for November[/h1]

To pull myself together, overcome shyness and laziness, and write to the BG artists I found. Perhaps this will solve the issue with backgrounds. (but if it doesn't work out, I still have a couple of ideas. I won't leave you without the game, heheeh)

And I haven't worked on the text for a long time. In fact, I stopped on a uhmmm.. an unexpected moment even for me that I just don't know how to continue the text itself, ahahahaha : DDD (still shocked by the behavior of some characters, hmm ...)

And sketches, yes. CGs are planned a little, but complex. Therefore, it would be worth starting work on them.

Sprites, sprites... continue)

Well, there are a lot to do :c (and I also plan to whine a lot.)

notes.title: Autumn cleaning'22
notes.notes:
Autumn cleaning
1. Update of the English translation.

The latest update is related to the update of the English translation in the game. 
We have corrected more than 1000 sentences!

Somewhere there were just small errors and inaccuracies. And somewhere there is a serious distortion of the meaning compared to the original, because of which some players might not have the right impression about the game.
One of the players helped us a lot with this (we'll probably keep his name a little secret for now), for which we thank him very much!

2. Assistance in walkthrough

We carefully study feedback from players, especially beginners. Quite a large number of complaints came to the fact that it is quite difficult to get any ending in the game on your own, without hints.
Here we decided to help new players who are launching the game for the first time. Or after playing for a while and coming across bad endings, they still want to get at least one good one.
As soon as you start the game (and if you haven't opened the ending #21 yet), the question arises whether you need help in walkthough. If the player agrees, then at each choice the game suggests what exactly needs to be done to reach the ending.

3. Added a candy recipe

Just to make it more fun.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: monthly update on a new act
notes.notes:
We have abandoned this site a little, which does not please us at all :c

We are going to improve that and start right from this post and try to do reports about the work done every month

What's going on now? 

We're working on the second act a little bit. Who will be the main love interest of the second act, we are keeping a secret for now - but wait for the teaser, it will definitely happen :3

Our plans for the second act: It will most likely have only one main love interest, because the size of the game itself will be smaller than the first. We would like to meet 5-7 hours of pure text. 

There will be more emphasis on the plot in this act than in the first act. There will be more lore, more opportunities to influence events, but there will be much more pain (✷‿✷)

We have already started to redraw the sprites (and we will definitely show what we are getting). 

About 30% of text is written, the translation has not yet even been started. (in numbers, 230k characters are written)

In short, this is everything is going on so far.

About the release date, everything is complicated. We were too arrogant in the last game and gave deadlines that we didn't observe ourselves... It was very sad for us to let the players down, so we will be much more careful in our plans now.

And let's put it this way - we would really like to release next year and we will do our best for this.

We attach a flowchart where part of the branching of the endings of the future act (yes, the consequences of the choices in this act will change the plot even more)

notes.title: Update after feedback
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have released a new version (BTW, check it out, we keep a detailed log of what was updated in the game and when - [url=https://degraman.tumblr.com/post/674471770864173057/release-notes-103]https://degraman.tumblr.com/post/674471770864173057/release-notes-103[/url])

The most important change in this update is that we have seriously changed the approach to what should be included in the free version in the first 4 chapters, and what should be included in the paid version.


Specifically: almost (almost) all the choose options from the paid version migrated to the free one (only in the first 4 chapters). I.e. Cassel's route and Loner route remained in the paid version.

Our hypothesis is that this way we will better show at the same time that there is a lot of variability within the game and what exactly the player should expect in the paid version.


If a player has a free version and gets to the Loner or Cassel route at the end of Chapter 4, we will show a warning screen and do not let him/her play on 😃

---

These changes are a consequence of the feedback that we collected during these six weeks after the release.

We want to say a special thanks to https://twitter.com/Aniva_666 and https://twitter.com/BlerdyOtome, without which these changes would not have ever happened.

---

P.S. we also changed the color of the reply message in messenger UI thanks to the feedback from https://twitter.com/otomeobsessed

P.P.S. More, More feedback!

P.P.P.S. Tomorrow will be sales 😉😉😉
